prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1066; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Front bumper cover cracked across the left side with the lower valance torn free, and the left headlamp assembly broken at its mounting tabs. The damage pattern lines up with the reported strike while turning left, with the impact landing at the front corner. Repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, headlamp, and left fender bracket, followed by refinishing and a sensor recalibration. Labor hours are in line with the extent of the damage shown. The shop's billing reflects one set of charges with no repeated line items. Nothing on the vehicle suggests earlier damage to these areas.
